# dr_libs

Single-file audio decoders by David Reid, used for audio tracks
(`src/appshell/qml/MuseScore/AppShell/audiofiledecoder.cpp`).

- Source: https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs (master, 2026-09-26)
- Files: `dr_wav.h`, `dr_mp3.h`, `dr_flac.h`, unmodified
- License: public domain (Unlicense) or, alternatively, MIT No Attribution, as
  stated at the end of each file. Both are compatible with GPL-3.0.
